chunks: I was sitting with Abu Abdullah عليه السلام
Then a man asked him: "May one enter ihram in a garment that contains silk?"
He said: so he called for a striped lower garment of his.
Then he said: "I enter ihram in this, and it contains silk."

key_terms.أُحْرِمُ: I enter the state of ihram
key_terms.إِزَارٍ: a lower wrap worn as clothing
key_terms.ثَوْبٍ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.فُرْقُبِيٍّ: striped; describing the type of garment

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to enter ihram wearing a garment that contains silk?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal question regarding what may be worn in the state of ihram. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام answers practically by pointing to his own garment containing silk, indicating the permissibility described in the report.
